annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence and the world of work – should we be scared?
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence and the world of work – should we be scared?
annotation.venue: ILO Voices – The Future of Work Podcast
annotation.summary_en: ILO Future of Work podcast episode 37 (28 April 2023) page on how AI is reshaping jobs and business practices. It asks whether AI can address inequality, stagnant productivity and weak fundamental rights, and how firms and workers can prepare. It gives only a description and links, with no transcript and no embodied-AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI is already creating, destroying and reshaping jobs and business practices.
There is hype and fear that AI cannot be regulated or controlled.
The episode asks whether AI can help address inequality, stagnant productivity and inadequate fundamental rights.
Businesses and workers need to prepare to avoid AI's pitfalls and capture its benefits.
